133:     if (self->step == mp_const_none) {
134:         step = 1;
135:     } else {
136:         step = mp_obj_get_int(self->step);
137:         if (step == 0) {
138:             mp_raise_ValueError(MP_ERROR_TEXT("slice step can't be zero"));
139:         }
140:     }

143:         // Positive step
144:         if (self->start == mp_const_none) {
145:             start = 0;
146:         } else {
147:             start = mp_obj_get_int(self->start);
148:             if (start < 0) {

150:             }

152:         }

155:             stop = length;

166:             start = length - 1;

169:             if (start < 0) {

183:         }
